findings.description: Color index 0 is silently ignored for both foreground and background colors.
findings.rationale: When style is called with fg=0 or bg=0, the new truthiness checks skip the color entirely. Zero is a valid ANSI palette index, so text that previously received the requested black foreground or background now uses the terminal's existing color.

findings.description: Invalid numeric colors now produce ANSI sequences instead of being rejected.
findings.rationale: For example, style('text', fg=256) now emits an out-of-range palette sequence, whereas it previously raised ValueError. Removing the component validation likewise accepts RGB values outside 0–255, allowing invalid colors to reach the terminal and produce ignored or unintended styling.
